SOURCE EXCERPT:
Export-controlled information may be stored only on university-managed systems approved for that purpose and listed in the controlled-systems register. A project becomes subject to these requirements when the award terms restrict publication or foreign-national participation, or when the technology appears on the Commerce Control List; the determination is made by the Export Compliance Officer before the award is accepted, not by the principal investigator. Foreign nationals may participate in a controlled project only under a licence or a documented exemption, and the licence covers named individuals rather than roles, so a personnel change requires an amendment. Travel to a sanctioned country with university equipment requires a separate review regardless of the project's control status. Violations are reported to the federal agency within five days of discovery by the Export Compliance Officer, and the report is made whether or not the principal investigator agrees with the finding.
